name: Michael Gahler - Après le § 33 - Am 58/1
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 33b. Recalls that, since the start of the war in Ukraine, Poland, together with other EU Member States, has emerged as a major refuge for Ukrainians, providing extensive aid to Ukrainian refugees, including housing, financial assistance, access to education and medical care; strongly condemns the decision by the President of Ukraine on 26 May 2026 to grant a Ukrainian military unit the name ‘Heroes of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army’; recalls that this formation was responsible for the genocide in Volhynia and mass crimes against Poles, Jews, Czechs, Russians, Armenians, other minorities and Ukrainians who opposed their actions, with some 100 000 to 120 000 victims; considers the prompt exhumation and proper burial of victims as a moral duty and an essential step towards justice, reconciliation and the strengthening of Polish-Ukrainian relations;
